subject.title: feat(macos): Quick Chat area capture and focused-app text context

question: Should Quick Chat be permitted to collect focused external-app text through macOS Accessibility and append it to a chat send under the PR’s proposed one-click, permission-gated interaction model?
rationale: This is an intentional new sensitive-data boundary rather than a mechanical correctness choice; source-level bounds and tests do not determine whether the product’s consent and disclosure model is acceptable.

options.title: Approve the gated capture model
options.body: Accept the user-initiated Accessibility capture design after current-head native proof and confirmation that role-only values cannot become message context.

options.title: Narrow the data boundary
options.body: Require a more explicit preview, confirmation, or restricted capture scope before app text may be attached to a send.

options.title: Pause focused-text capture
options.body: Land neither focused-text behavior nor its permission flow until maintainers choose a durable privacy and UX contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the gated capture model
recommendation.body: Accept the user-initiated Accessibility capture design after current-head native proof and confirmation that role-only values cannot become message context.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the assigned author of the proposed macOS Quick Chat feature and its documented consent behavior.
